mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.0% compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 months), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as rate hike expectations intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly non-farm payrolls increase above 150,000 signals robust labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 150,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
